beginning: Ren copies the week's repairs into the loft ledger and finds three towers logged with no name.
climax: At tower seven the fresh solder, the trued minute hand, and the placed plank identify Sable.
ending: Ren returns to the loft and writes Sable's name into every unattributed entry.
logline: An apprentice clockwright traces a week of unsigned repairs and finds the mentor who has been fixing the city for free.

setting: Vell, a canal city whose public clocks are maintained by a small guild of clockwrights.
theme: Unrecorded care is still care, and recording it is its own kind of repair.
title: The Quiet Ledger
turn: Tower seven runs four minutes fast, and its repair is newer than any logged entry.
